messages.subject: For Leonardo Contreras | Government relations, stakeholder strategy and copper growth
messages.body:
Dear Southern Copper Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Leonardo Contreras Lerdo de Tejada, Chief Executive Officer.

Southern Copper's scale across Peru and Mexico places government relations, community confidence, regulatory coordination and disciplined stakeholder execution at the center of long-term value creation. Those priorities align closely with the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and complex cross-functional matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, social performance, corporate affairs and mining execution might support Southern Copper's priorities in Latin America. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Southern Copper.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
